SATURDAY FOUNDRY · COACH COLLECTION

Coaches Card

Portrait on the front. Every career, season, record and rivalry stat on the back.

📅 LEAGUE CONTROL

Active Week

Controls the week surfaced throughout Saturday Foundry. The league auto-advances after every player-controlled game in the active week is complete; CPU-only games never hold the week back.

★ NATIONAL POLL

Top 25 Rankings Manager

Save the official poll for a specific week. Paste one team per line as rank | team | record, for example 1 | Ohio State | 8-0. Saving also stamps that week's game participants with the official game-time ranking snapshot.

🎟️ MEMBERS

Invite Center

Create and manage member access. Invite codes are shown only when generated; active invites can be revoked at any time.

ACTIVE INVITES
🔴 COACH MEDIA

Live Streams

Configure each coach’s stream once. The link follows the coach across teams and seasons and appears automatically on the Foundry coach card and any player-controlled matchup. CPU-only games never show a stream.

🎰 DYNASTY VEGAS CONTROL

Market Desk

Inspect, refresh, lock, unlock, or manually override stored pregame lines. Vegas controls never block schedule management.

🏅 AWARDS & HARDWARE

Heisman Trophy

Record a Heisman winner for a coach/program. Trophy Room totals update from the award ledger.

🗓️ SEASONS

Start Next Season

Completes the current active season and creates the next one.

🧳 COACHING CAROUSEL

Change Program

Coaching changes are available between seasons, before games begin. Prior-team games, trophies, rivalries and career history remain permanently attached to the coach's career ledger.

🏈 COACH ADMINISTRATION

Retire Coach / Remove From Dynasty

Remove a coach from active participation while preserving the complete career ledger, completed games, trophies and historical records.
